name: website-design-system-architect
description: Create or evolve an implementation-agnostic design system from verified evidence, including Visual Identity Drivers, a restrained Visual Budget, complete component states, and Motion Character. Use to establish a new baseline, extract an existing site's rendered system, validate one selected direction with a compact Design Board, or update repeated shared rules. Do not research references, map Elementor settings, create page layouts, design modules, or implement code.
